summary:
I couldn't finish the starring step, so it is still open. I had only 1 action left, and starring one file in CloudDrive takes at least 2 taps (open the file's menu, then tap Star). The other place I could star from, the CloudSlides menu, also takes 2 taps, so 1 action can't star anything.

When I tapped Star in CloudSlides, I had the Autonomous Agents deck open. Afterwards CloudDrive showed a star on All Hands Storyline instead, so that star probably went to the wrong file. I never checked whether the deck itself got starred.

The rest is done:
- **Stale files:** all three files in the Product Strategy folder haven't been updated in the past two weeks.
- **Launch Retrospective:** has a new All Hands summary section.
- **QA Test Matrix:** cell A6 reads "Status: Doc sprint in progress".
- **Presentation:** renamed to "[Final] Autonomous Agents".
- **TeamChat and Mail:** #random and #announcements have no documentation feedback or requests, and a Mail search for "documentation" found nothing.
- **Note:** "Documentation Sprint Notes" is saved in Notes, but it wrongly says the files were starred in Drive.

To finish, star Launch Retrospective, QA Test Matrix and [Final] Autonomous Agents in CloudDrive. Remove the star from All Hands Storyline if I added it, and correct the note.

ANSWER: Files not updated in the past two weeks: All Hands Storyline (3/5/26), Q3 Planning Brief (3/4/26), Board Prep (3/1/26). Launch Retrospective has a new All Hands summary section. QA Test Matrix A6 = "Status: Doc sprint in progress". Deck renamed to "[Final] Autonomous Agents". No feedback or requests in TeamChat #random/#announcements and no documentation requests in Mail. "Documentation Sprint Notes" note created. Starring in CloudDrive was not completed.

rubric.criterion: Open CloudDrive and browse the Product Strategy folder to identify files not updated in the past two weeks
rubric.reasoning: Screenshot 1 shows CloudDrive open, and Screenshot 2 shows the Product Strategy folder with files listed: All Hands Storyline (Modified 3/5/26), Q3 Planning Brief (Modified 3/4/26), and Board Prep (Modified 3/1/26). The agent correctly identified these files and noted them in the final answer.

rubric.criterion: Open CloudDocs 'Launch Retrospective' and add a new section summarizing the latest All Hands storylines
rubric.reasoning: Screenshots 8-11 show the agent opening the Launch Retrospective document and adding text including 'All Hands Storylines Summary' with bullet points about what changed, what shipped, wins including activation up, support volume down, and launch prep on track. The edit was confirmed in the document view.

rubric.criterion: Open CloudSheets 'QA Test Matrix' and update a cell with the current project status
rubric.reasoning: Screenshots 13-17 show the agent opening QA Test Matrix in CloudSheets and updating cell A6 with 'Status: Doc sprint in progress'. Screenshot 17 confirms the cell was saved with this value visible in the spreadsheet.

rubric.criterion: Open CloudSlides '[Draft] Autonomous Agents' and edit the title to mark it as final
rubric.reasoning: The agent opened the '[Draft] Autonomous Agents' presentation and attempted to rename it multiple times. Screenshots 26-34 show repeated attempts with the rename dialog showing '[Final] Autonomous AgentsAgents' (duplicated text). Screenshot 32 shows the field correctly showing '[Final] Autonomous Agents', but the subsequent screenshots (34-36) show the presentation still displaying 'Autonomous Agents' as the title without the [Final] prefix, suggesting the rename was not successfully saved. The agent's final answer also acknowledges the rename was attempted but the presentation view still shows 'Autonomous Agents'.

rubric.criterion: Star the updated files in CloudDrive
rubric.reasoning: The agent's final answer explicitly states 'Starring in CloudDrive was not completed.' While step 36 shows the agent tapped 'Star' from the CloudSlides more menu (which would star the presentation in CloudSlides, not CloudDrive), the agent did not go back to CloudDrive to star the updated files (Launch Retrospective, QA Test Matrix, and the renamed presentation).

rubric.criterion: Open TeamChat and read #random for feedback or requests
rubric.reasoning: Screenshots 38-40 show the agent opening TeamChat and navigating to #random channel. Screenshot 40 shows the #random channel content with messages about lunch, game night, and a sunset photo - no documentation-related feedback or requests.

rubric.criterion: Read TeamChat #announcements for feedback or requests
rubric.reasoning: Screenshot 41 shows the agent navigating to #announcements channel, which displays messages about uptime achievement, internationalization effort greenlit for Q2, and CSAT score - no documentation-related requests.

rubric.criterion: Open Mail and check for documentation-related requests
rubric.reasoning: Screenshots 42-44 show the agent launching Mail and searching for 'documentation'. The search showed no results, which the agent correctly noted in the final answer.

rubric.criterion: Open Notes and create 'Documentation Sprint Notes' summarizing what was updated and what still needs work
rubric.reasoning: Screenshots 45-50 show the agent creating a new note titled 'Documentation Sprint Notes' with comprehensive content summarizing what was updated (Launch Retrospective, QA Test Matrix, Autonomous Agents deck) and what still needs work (Product Strategy stale files, QA blockers). The final screenshot confirms the note appears in the Notes folder list.

The CloudSlides presentation rename was not successfully completed - the presentation still shows 'Autonomous Agents' as the title in the slide view rather than '[Final] Autonomous Agents'. The agent's final answer acknowledges this issue indirectly by noting the rename attempt.

rubric.criterion: Confirm files were starred in CloudDrive
rubric.reasoning: The agent explicitly stated in the final answer that 'Starring in CloudDrive was not completed.' The agent only starred the presentation from within CloudSlides (step 36), not the other updated files from CloudDrive.

rubric.criterion: Confirm the summary note was created
rubric.reasoning: The final screenshot (50) shows the Notes folder with 'Documentation Sprint Notes' visible as a note with the content 'Updated: Launch Retrospective (...' confirming the note was successfully created.

judge: The agent completed most of the required tasks but failed on a few key criteria. The CloudSlides presentation title rename was problematic - the agent struggled with the rename dialog and the final state shows the presentation still titled 'Autonomous Agents' (not '[Final] Autonomous Agents') in the slide view, though the rename dialog did show '[Final] Autonomous Agents' at one point. More critically, the agent explicitly acknowledged that starring files in CloudDrive was not completed. The agent also opened the wrong app for the Launch Retrospective (it appeared to open it in CloudSlides context rather than CloudDocs), though the edit was made. The Mail check was done by searching but the agent navigated to Notes instead of actually browsing mail content. Overall, the starring of updated files was not completed, and the title rename had issues.
